title: Concentration of Viruses from Wastewater Influent Using Organic Flocculation (PEG)
author: Katy Graham
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bi6jkhcn
materials: RNA extraction is performed using the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral Kit. Before starting: Prepare Solution PM1/β-ME: Warm Solution PM1 at 55 °C for 00:10:00 prior to use to dissolve precipitates. Use Solution PM1 while still warm. Shake to mix before using. Add β-ME to Solution PM1 to produce a mixture of Solution PM1/β-ME with a final β-ME concentration of 10 μl/ml ( 6 µL of β-ME with 594 µL warm PM1 per sample). The mixture of Solution PM1/β-ME loses its effectiveness over time, so prepare a fresh batch each time you use the kit. You will need 600 µL of the Solution PM1/β-ME mixture per prep.
Put column into a labeled 1.5mL LoBind tube.
Gently vortex to resuspend the pellet.

steps.title: Thaw samples and record volume
steps.instruction: Remove frozen samples, thaw at 4 °C (≈5 h for a 50 mL tube) and do not exceed 24 h before processing; record the exact sample volume; keep biosafety practices, never open outside a BSC and bring the centrifuge rotor into the BSC before opening.

steps.title: Initial centrifugation to remove solids
steps.instruction: Load balanced tubes into the rotor, centrifuge at 24 000 × g, 4 °C for 15 min; this pellets suspended solids.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: In the BSC, pipette ≈40 mL supernatant from each tube, avoiding the pellet, into a new 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add PEG8000 and NaCl
steps.instruction: Add PEG8000 (8 g per 100 mL of sample) and NaCl (0.2 M) calculated for the actual sample volume; vortex gently if PEG clumps and shake to mix.

steps.title: Incubate PEG mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 4 °C overnight (minimum 4 h if a single‑day protocol is required).

steps.title: Spike with BCoV stock
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL BCoV stock (Bovilis Coronavirus Calf Vaccine, Merck Animal Health, Cat. #16445) to each tube, vortex gently, and equilibrate on ice for 30 min (00:30:00).

steps.title: Second centrifugation to pellet virus
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from 4 °C the next morning, load balanced rotor, centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Discard supernatant and wash pellet
steps.instruction: Discard ≈20 mL supernatant, wash the tube sides with the remaining supernatant, then centrifuge again at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 20 min.

substeps.instruction: Wash tube sides with remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Remove final supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette off the remaining supernatant carefully (pellet may be invisible or look like faint dirt).

steps.title: Transfer viral concentrate to PowerBead tube
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of the viral concentrate into a PowerBead Tube (glass beads, 0.1 mm); include one extraction blank per set of extractions.

steps.title: Add PM1/β‑ME mixture
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Solution PM1/β‑ME mixture to the PowerBead tube.

steps.title: Vortex with adapter
steps.instruction: Secure tubes horizontally on a Vortex Adapter (cat. no. 13000‑V1‑24) with caps pointing toward the center; vortex at maximum speed for 10 min inside the BSC.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, 1 min; transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube, pushing the tip into the beads to recover all liquid (beads may be carried over).

steps.title: Add inhibitor removal solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Solution IRS (inhibitor removal solution), vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C or on ice for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer IRS supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 1 min; transfer ≤700 µL supernatant to a clean 2.2 mL collection tube (avoid pellet).

steps.title: Add PM3 and PM4
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL each of Solution PM3 and Solution PM4 to the tube and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto MB Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load 625 µL of the collected supernatant onto an MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 1 min, discard flow‑through; repeat until all supernatant is loaded.

steps.title: Add PM5 and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Mix Solution PM5, add 600 µL to the MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 1 min.

steps.title: Add PM4 second wash
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through, add 600 µL Solution PM4, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 1 min.

steps.title: Final spin to remove buffer
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through and centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 2 min to eliminate residual buffer.

steps.title: Place column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the MB Spin Column to a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid with RNase‑Free water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL RNase‑Free water to the column membrane, incubate 5 min at room temperature, pipetting directly onto the membrane with a REACH tip if needed.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 1 min; discard the column. The eluate (DNA/RNA) is ready for downstream work; proceed with inhibitor removal immediately before storage.

steps.title: Add Prep solution and spin
steps.instruction: Place one column into a collection tube per sample, add 600 µL Prep solution, spin at 8 000 × g, 3 min, and discard the flow‑through tube.

steps.title: Add extract and final spin
steps.instruction: Add ~50 µL RNA/DNA extract to each column and spin at 16 000 × g, 3 min.

steps.title: Quantify and store extract
steps.instruction: Measure nucleic acid with Nanodrop, Qubit, or RT‑qPCR and store at –80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining pellet in a total of 200 µL using 1× PBS to supplement any liquid left in the tube.

steps.title: Store resuspended pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the 200 µL suspension to a 1 mL cryotube and store at –80 °C.
